t: Alternative to the final of scene III
Variant of the duet between Ilia and Idamante of scene II
d: Ideasant, Ilia, Trojan prisoners, Cretan men and women.
Beaches of the sea still agitated, surrounded by cliffs. Broken ships on the beach. Cretan people and Marinai.
Port of Sidon with vessels along the beaches. Elettra, Argivi troops, Cretesi and Marinari.
Idomeneus, Idamante, Elettra, Follow of the King.
Scene with round K. 490 of the 1786 version.
Dialogue between Idomeneus and Electra after the air of Idomeneus (Fuor of the sea I have a sea in my bosom).

Great square embellished with statues before the palace, of which the frontispiece is seen on one side. Idomeneus arrives accompanied by Arbace and the royal Follow; the escorted King of Arbace sits on the throne destined for public audiences; Great Priest and quantity of People.

An external view of the magnificent temple of Neptune with a vast atrium that surrounds it, through which the beach of the sea is discovered far away. The atrium and the galleries of the temple are filled with a multitude of people, the Priests prepare the things belonging to the sacrifice.
Idamante in white robe, garland of flowers on the head, surrounded by Guards and Priests. Multitude of mesto People and above.
Idomeneus, Idamante, Ilia, Arbace, Séguito d'Idomeneus, d'Idamante and d'Ilia; People.
